name: codex-thread-memory-owner
title: Codex thread memory owner convergence
description: Strengthen NovusAI memory governance from a normalized thread snapshot into a more explicit thread-owned runtime lifecycle with startup, capture, recall, and pollution controls.
creator: yudi
notes: This workstream should land before final runtime-core convergence so thread memory ownership is not re-embedded into entrypoint glue. 2026-04-21 audit follow-up: `ExecutionResult.memory_runtime_policy` is now the public owner field for command/stream persistence instead of `_memory_runtime_policy`, and marker-only stream error persistence also mirrors `thread_memory_state` onto conversation metadata so thread-owned memory state survives the narrowest fallback path.
